title: Machine learning and mutant assays map a navigable AAV2 capsid sequence subspace
summary: Combining high-throughput DNA synthesis with machine learning, the authors assayed 232,123 AAV2 capsid mutants around 15 seed neighborhoods and report a percolating network of function-preserving ridges with trajectories up to 667 steps. Designed variants with mutations largely absent from evolution, combining up to 7 individually lethal mutations, retained packaging in the tested backgrounds. This is a preprint read at abstract level; held-out prediction accuracy is not stated.
ai_technology: Machine-learning model of sitewise effects transformed by global epistasis, fit to AAV2 packaging assay data and used to design variants
organization: Wyss Institute for Biologically Inspired Engineering

evidence.tested: Packaging assays of 232,123 mutants and of designed variants across 15 backgrounds.
evidence.unknown: Held-out predictive accuracy and therapeutic usefulness of the variants. Full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Modeled mutational effects to design variants outside the evolutionary background.
